title.en: The inverter stopped following the plan

hint.en: The battery has not done what the plan says for 20 minutes, the inverter settings were changed outside the app, or no data has arrived for 20 minutes.
hint.sv: Batteriet har inte gjort som planen säger på 20 minuter, växelriktarens inställningar ändrades utanför appen, eller ingen data har kommit på 20 minuter.

example.en: Planned grid charging, but the battery is not charging
